rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; p525 p. 27, Worksheet 2, line 2, footnote 2. A refund of general sales tax is refused: rec.sales_tax (asked among the recovery kinds) refuses through rec.sales_tax_if_any (forms/2025/rec.yaml), as the form's note says ('a recovery ... of general sales tax ... refused'). The restatement shows line 2 without that refusal, which sits on another line.

rulings.model: Worksheet 2a line 1 says only "Enter the income tax refund from Form(s) 1099-G (or similar statement)". Zero is right when you didn't itemize or deducted sales taxes, but the program also enters zero when the refunds were of both spouses' tax on separate 2024 returns. The text doesn't cover that case, and no refusal names it as excluded.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.refund_two_returns (i1040gi p. 90 tests a refund against one 2024 return): on a joint 2025 return with refunds of both spouses' tax on separate 2024 returns the chosen reading takes none as taxable when neither return itemized state and local income taxes, and refuses otherwise. The zero the reviewer flags is that registered reading.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.rec_line5 (p525 p. 27, line 5, 'Enter any amount previously refunded to you'): chosen reading zero for 2024 deductions recovered in 2025, since an amount refunded during 2024 reduced the 2024 deduction itself; recoveries for years before 2024 are refused (rec.not_2024_if_any).
